author: blu
body: The capability table, once. A capability used to be written out five times: the vocabulary the type checker admits, the identifier the CDX manifest carries, the kernel bits the boot grant expands, the kernel bits the verified loader expands, and the bit numbers themselves, which existed twice under two names. Four of those live in the compiler and the fifth lives in the operating system, and no single compile ever saw more than one quire at a time -- so the agreement between them was checked by a build script rather than held by the language.

author: blu
body: The bit positions the kernel grants authority in. These were the compiler's `cap-*` family and the loader's `kern-cap-*` family; the names here are the compiler's, because it had 55 uses across six files against the loader's 17 in one, so keeping this spelling left the larger side untouched.

author: blu
body: A grant is read, write, or both. The compiler wrote these as `manifest-dir-*` and the CDX format wrote them as `cdx-dir-*`, with the same three values, and this section used to say that both AGREED with these -- which was true, and was true the way the `cap-*` and `kern-cap-*` families were true before this chapter existed: by inspection, held by nobody.

author: blu
body: That is now closed the same way the rest of the table was. `manifest-dir-*` is deleted and the compiler reads these names directly. `cdx-dir-*` keeps its spelling, because it genuinely names a byte in a file format rather than a value, but it is defined from these and is no longer a second copy.

author: blu
body: One expansion, read by the boot grant and by the verified loader. A family with no direction takes readwrite when it is asked for one, which is what both hand-written expansions did: withholding a bit the family does not model would deny an authority the program correctly declared.

author: blu
body: A miss answers negative one for an identifier and zero for a bit mask. Zero is the honest answer for an unknown capability: no authority. Both hand-written expansions ended in exactly that and this keeps it.

author: blu
body: The names the type checker admits in an effect row: every capability, plus a dotted Read and Write for the three families that have a direction. 18 rows give 24 names.

author: blu
body: This is a membership test at every call site, so the order is not load-bearing and this does not reproduce the order the hand-written list happened to be in.
